how_it_works: auto_save_event() fires on every session_event_handler POST
Only saves Message and ToolResult events (skips SessionStart/End/Error)
Updates sync metrics automatically via SessionSyncTask::update_metrics()

strengths: Non-blocking: fire-and-forget pattern doesn't slow down HTTP responses
Selective: only important events (Message, ToolResult) are persisted
potential_issues: No deduplication: if same message sent twice, it saves twice
No batching: each event is a separate HTTP request to /memory/add
No retry logic on timeout — events are lost if Xavier is temporarily down
failed-syncs directory grows unbounded — needs cleanup cron
recommendations: Add in-memory buffer with batch flush every 5s for high-throughput scenarios
Add retry with exponential backoff (3 retries max)
Add deduplication key based on session_id + content_hash

how_it_works: After SAVE to /memory/add, immediately calls AutoVerifier::verify_save()
If match_score < 0.8 → writes to failed-syncs/ + logs warning

strengths: Leverages existing AutoVerifier infrastructure — no code duplication
Immediate feedback loop detects silent failures
Persistent audit trail in failed-syncs/ directory
potential_issues: Doubles latency: every save triggers a search immediately after
Verification uses exact content search — may fail on embeddings delay
No distinction between 'save failed' vs 'retrieval failed' vs 'content mismatch'
match_score 0.8 threshold may be too strict for long content with minor formatting changes
recommendations: Make verification async-deferred (verify 5s after save to allow indexing)
Add separate alerts for: save_ok=false, retrieve_ok=false, match_score<threshold
Use semantic similarity instead of exact text match for better tolerance
Consider sampling: verify only 10% of saves to reduce load

strengths: Separation between openui_lang (legacy) and xui_json (new standard)
recommendations: Add validation that xui_json contains valid JSON when Some()
Document the expected JSON schema for xui_json
Consider adding xui_json to the event_mapper for session persistence
